# pub title
title: "How VR Systems Impact Virtual Navigation for Blind People"

# short description of the publication
description: "We investigated how using VR and Game Controllers impacts performance in navigation tasks, for blind people. Additionally, as virtual environments can offer various degrees of complexity, we observed how participants performed under different cognitive demands.  Our findings showed that VR improved navigation performance, whereas adding a simultaneous cognitive task decreased performance in both conditions."
